_comment: Written from the description of the rules only, without seeing the code: value + rule + ctx -> true, false or null. Each rule must also pass compileRules.

vectors.name: date-before-today-yesterday-late-time
vectors.why: Day 2026-10-05 < today; the time part is ignored.

vectors.name: date-before-today-same-day-midnight
vectors.why: Same day as today, so not before, even at 00:00 (a timestamp comparison would get this wrong).

vectors.name: date-after-today-same-day-late-space-time
vectors.why: Late time today is still today, not after; the space-separated time form is valid.

vectors.name: date-is-today-space-seconds
vectors.why: The first 10 chars equal ctx.today; the ' HH:MM:SS' suffix is allowed.

vectors.name: date-is-fixed-T-minutes
vectors.why: The legacy 16-char 'THH:MM' form matches the fixed day.

vectors.name: date-nextDays-today-counts
vectors.why: Lower bound T <= d is inclusive, even when the time has already passed.

vectors.name: date-nextDays-upper-inclusive-late-time
vectors.why: d = T+7 = 2026-10-13; the upper bound is inclusive and the time is ignored.

vectors.name: date-nextDays-yesterday-excluded
vectors.why: Past dates are not 'within the next N days'.

vectors.name: date-nextDays-month-crossing
vectors.why: T+1 from Jan 31 rolls over to Feb 1.

vectors.name: date-nextDays-year-crossing-past-upper
vectors.why: 2027-01-05 is one day past T+5.

vectors.name: date-nextDays-leap-day
vectors.why: 2028 is a leap year, so T+1 = 2028-02-29.

vectors.name: date-nextDays-leap-skips-march1
vectors.why: In a leap year T+1 is Feb 29, so Mar 1 is outside the window.

vectors.name: date-nextDays-nonleap-march1
vectors.why: 2027 is not a leap year, so T+1 = 2027-03-01.

vectors.name: date-nextDays-3650-upper
vectors.why: 2026-10-06 + 3650 days = 2036-10-03 (three leap days fall in between); the upper bound is inclusive.

vectors.name: date-olderThanDays-exact-boundary
vectors.why: T-30 = 2026-09-06 and the rule is strict d < T-30.

vectors.name: date-olderThanDays-one-beyond-with-time
vectors.why: 2026-09-05 < 2026-09-06; the time is ignored.

vectors.name: date-olderThanDays-yesterday-not-older-than-1
vectors.why: T-1 = 2026-10-05 and d < T-1 is strict, so yesterday does not match.

vectors.name: date-olderThanDays-leap-feb28
vectors.why: T-1 = 2028-02-29 (leap year); Feb 28 < Feb 29.

vectors.name: date-olderThanDays-leap-feb29
vectors.why: d = T-1 = 2028-02-29, which fails the strict d < T-1.

vectors.name: date-olderThanDays-dst-boundary
vectors.why: T-1 = 2026-03-29 (the EU DST day of 23 hours); ms arithmetic in local time could shift it a day.

vectors.name: date-olderThanDays-3650-true
vectors.why: T-3650 = 2016-10-08 (two leap days fall in between); 2016-10-07 < that.

vectors.name: date-olderThanDays-3650-boundary
vectors.why: d = T-3650 exactly; the comparison is strict.

vectors.name: date-before-fixed-year-crossing
vectors.why: 2026-12-31 < 2027-01-01 against a fixed operand; ctx.today is irrelevant.

vectors.name: date-impossible-feb30
vectors.why: Impossible date gives unknown; a plain string compare would wrongly say true.

vectors.name: date-nonleap-feb29
vectors.why: 2026 is not a leap year, so Feb 29 is impossible.

vectors.name: date-1900-feb29
vectors.why: 1900 is divisible by 100 but not by 400, so it is not a leap year.

vectors.name: date-2000-feb29-valid
vectors.why: 2000 is a leap year (divisible by 400), so the date is valid and in the past.

vectors.name: date-leap-is-fixed-with-time
vectors.why: A valid leap-day datetime equals the fixed leap-day operand.

vectors.name: date-month13
vectors.why: Month 13 is impossible, so unknown (a string compare would say after).

vectors.name: date-april31
vectors.why: April has 30 days; Date.UTC would roll this to May 1 without a round-trip check.

vectors.name: date-impossible-with-time
vectors.why: An impossible day with a time part is still invalid; rollover to Mar 2 must not happen.

vectors.name: date-dmy-format
vectors.why: DD-MM-YYYY is not the stored format, so unknown.

vectors.name: date-slash-format
vectors.why: Slash separators are another format, so unknown.

vectors.name: date-unpadded
vectors.why: A day without zero padding does not match YYYY-MM-DD; a lenient parser would wrongly match today.

vectors.name: date-space-value
vectors.why: ' ' is a value (not empty) but not a date, so unknown rather than false.

vectors.name: date-zero-value
vectors.why: '0' is a value, not empty, and not a parsable date.

vectors.name: date-impossible-notEmpty
vectors.why: !empty only checks presence; an unparsable date is still a value.

vectors.name: date-impossible-empty
vectors.why: An invalid date is not empty; empty must not return null for it.

vectors.name: date-empty-before
vectors.why: An empty value gives false for every date comparison (not null; '' < '2026-10-06' as strings would be true).

vectors.name: date-null-nextDays
vectors.why: A null value is empty, so the date comparison is false.

vectors.name: date-missing-olderThanDays
vectors.why: A missing (undefined) value is empty, so false.

vectors.name: date-missing-empty
vectors.why: Undefined counts as empty on a file row.

vectors.name: date-no-today-before
vectors.why: {today:0} cannot be resolved without ctx.today, so unknown.

vectors.name: date-no-today-nextDays
vectors.why: nextDays needs ctx.today, so unknown.

vectors.name: date-far-future-after
vectors.why: Valid far-future date, after today.

vectors.name: date-year-0099-valid
vectors.why: 0099-01-01 is a real calendar date (not impossible) and before today. Date.UTC maps years 0-99 to 19xx, so a naive round-trip check returns null. Low-stakes edge case.

vectors.name: folder-empty-date-empty
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file: an empty value is empty.

vectors.name: folder-missing-checkbox-isFalse
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file: no value is not checked.

vectors.name: folder-null-text-notIs
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file: !is on an empty value is true.

vectors.name: folder-empty-number-notIs
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file: number !is on an empty value is true.

vectors.name: folder-multiselect-emptylist-empty
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file: ";#" without items is empty.

vectors.name: folder-date-value-before
vectors.why: A folder with a value is evaluated normally.

vectors.name: folder-checkbox-zero-isFalse
vectors.why: '0' is a value (unchecked), so a folder row is evaluated normally.

vectors.name: folder-impossible-date
vectors.why: A folder with a non-empty value is evaluated normally, and an impossible date gives null.

vectors.name: checkbox-missing-isFalse
vectors.why: On a file row isFalse matches 'never set' (empty).

vectors.name: text-empty-notContains
vectors.why: !contains on an empty value is true (as in Flow).

vectors.name: multiselect-emptylist-empty
vectors.why: A ';#' list without items is empty for multi_select.

vectors.name: multiselect-double-delim-notEmpty
vectors.why: ';#;#' splits into no real items, so it is empty and !empty is false.

vectors.name: text-delim-is-a-value
vectors.why: The empty-list rule only applies to multiselect/filelink; for text ';#' is ordinary content.

vectors.name: truncated-text-contains
vectors.why: A truncated value cannot be read reliably, so content operators give null even when the prefix matches.

vectors.name: truncated-text-notIs
vectors.why: Negated content operators also read the content, so null.

vectors.name: truncated-text-notEmpty
vectors.why: !empty is evaluated normally on a truncated value.

vectors.name: truncated-date-is-today
vectors.why: The date comparison reads the content, so a truncated value gives null even when it looks like today.

vectors.name: truncated-checkbox-isTrue
vectors.why: Cut off: only empty/!empty are decided; isTrue reads the value (spec decision, 10-2026).

vectors.name: truncated-folder-contains
vectors.why: A folder with a value is evaluated normally, and a content rule on a truncated value gives null.

vectors.name: truncated-multiselect-oneOf
vectors.why: oneOf reads the items; the list may be cut off, so null.

vectors.name: num-numeric-not-string-compare
vectors.why: 10 > 9 numerically; a string compare would say "10" < "9"

vectors.name: num-operand-json-number
vectors.why: JSON-number operand counts as numeric 10; 9 < 10

vectors.name: num-is-1.0-equals-1
vectors.why: is compares as numbers, not strings

vectors.name: num-surrounding-spaces
vectors.why: PHP 8 is_numeric accepts leading and trailing whitespace

vectors.name: num-trailing-dot
vectors.why: PHP is_numeric("5.") is true (verified on PHP 8.5); a too-strict regex would reject it

vectors.name: num-plus-dot
vectors.why: sign plus leading dot is numeric (PHP is_numeric true)

vectors.name: num-comma-decimal
vectors.why: "1,5" is not is_numeric, so unknown

vectors.name: num-trailing-garbage
vectors.why: parseFloat would give 12; is_numeric rejects it

vectors.name: num-hex
vectors.why: hex rejected by is_numeric (JS Number gives 26)

vectors.name: num-infinity
vectors.why: is_numeric("Infinity") is false (JS Number gives Infinity)

vectors.name: num-nbsp
vectors.why: NBSP is not is_numeric whitespace (PHP false), though JS \s, trim() and Number() accept it

vectors.name: num-space-only-not-zero
vectors.why: " " is a value (not empty) and not numeric; Number(" ") === 0 is a trap

vectors.name: num-empty-is-zero
vectors.why: empty value: is gives false (Number("") === 0 is a trap)

vectors.name: num-empty-not-is
vectors.why: empty value: !is gives true

vectors.name: num-zero-string-not-empty
vectors.why: "0" is a value, not empty

vectors.name: num-zero-number-not-empty
vectors.why: number 0 is a value; a falsy check would call it empty

vectors.name: num-gte-boundary
vectors.why: 5 >= 5.0 numerically

vectors.name: num-not-is-nonnumeric
vectors.why: non-numeric value gives unknown even for !is (never a match)

vectors.name: num-truncated-content-op
vectors.why: truncated: content operators are unknown

vectors.name: text-case-insensitive
vectors.why: text compare is case-insensitive

vectors.name: text-operand-trimmed
vectors.why: rule operand is trimmed

vectors.name: text-value-not-trimmed
vectors.why: stored value is not trimmed: "done " != "done"

vectors.name: text-not-is-value-not-trimmed
vectors.why: stored value not trimmed, so !is holds

vectors.name: text-contains-operand-trimmed
vectors.why: operand trimmed to "b", case-insensitive substring of "abc"

vectors.name: text-contains-on-empty
vectors.why: contains on empty gives false

vectors.name: text-not-contains-missing
vectors.why: missing value is empty; !contains on empty gives true

vectors.name: text-space-is-a-value
vectors.why: " " is a value, not empty (no trimming)

vectors.name: text-delims-not-empty
vectors.why: ";#" counts as empty only for multiselect/multi_select/filelink

vectors.name: url-case-insensitive-contains
vectors.why: url is text-like: case-insensitive contains

vectors.name: text-truncated-not-contains
vectors.why: truncated: !contains reads content, so unknown (not true)

vectors.name: text-truncated-empty
vectors.why: truncated: empty is evaluated normally

vectors.name: text-folder-empty-not-is
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file: !is on an empty value is true.

vectors.name: text-folder-with-value
vectors.why: folder with a value is evaluated normally

vectors.name: select-case-insensitive
vectors.why: select is: whole value, case-insensitive

vectors.name: select-oneOf-whole-value-not-split
vectors.why: select compares the whole value; it does not split on ";#" like multiselect

vectors.name: select-oneOf-trimmed-items
vectors.why: operand items trimmed and compared case-insensitively

vectors.name: select-not-is-empty
vectors.why: select !is on empty gives true

vectors.name: dropdown-alias-oneOf
vectors.why: dropdown behaves like select

vectors.name: multi-oneOf-item
vectors.why: per-item match, case-insensitive

vectors.name: multi-oneOf-no-substring
vectors.why: exact item match, never substring

vectors.name: multi-containsAll-true
vectors.why: all operand items present (trimmed, case-insensitive)

vectors.name: multi-containsAll-false
vectors.why: yellow is missing

vectors.name: multi-delims-only-empty
vectors.why: ";#" list without items is empty

vectors.name: multi-leading-trailing-delims
vectors.why: empty items dropped (splitMulti); "Red" matches

vectors.name: multi-truncated-containsAll
vectors.why: truncated: content operators unknown

vectors.name: cb-string-1
vectors.why: "1" is checked

vectors.name: cb-number-1
vectors.why: number 1 is checked

vectors.name: boolean-string-false
vectors.why: "false" is unchecked; boolean is an alias of checkbox

vectors.name: cb-number-0
vectors.why: number 0 is unchecked (and not empty)

vectors.name: cb-missing-isFalse
vectors.why: never set (missing) counts as false

vectors.name: cb-empty-isTrue
vectors.why: empty is not checked

vectors.name: cb-capital-True
vectors.why: only exact '1','true',true,1 count as checked (TRUTHY set)

vectors.name: cb-space-isFalse
vectors.why: " " is a value, neither unchecked nor empty

vectors.name: cb-folder-missing-isFalse
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file: no value is not checked.

vectors.name: cb-truncated-isTrue
vectors.why: Cut off: only empty/!empty are decided; isTrue reads the value (spec decision, 10-2026).

vectors.name: user-uid-case
vectors.why: uid compare is case-insensitive

vectors.name: user-me-case
vectors.why: value equals ctx.me case-insensitively

vectors.name: user-me-other
vectors.why: value is not the viewer

vectors.name: user-me-no-viewer
vectors.why: ctx.me missing: unknown

vectors.name: user-me-empty-value
vectors.why: empty value never equals the viewer

vectors.name: user-me-truncated
vectors.why: truncated: content operators unknown

vectors.name: user-folder-empty-me-null
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file: "is the person viewing" without a known viewer cannot be known.

vectors.name: filelink-delims-empty
vectors.why: filelink ";#" without items is empty

vectors.name: filelink-one-item
vectors.why: one item present

vectors.name: filelink-truncated-not-empty
vectors.why: truncated: !empty is evaluated normally

vectors.name: unknown-delims-is-value
vectors.why: unknown type: ";#" is a plain value, not empty

vectors.name: unknown-empty
vectors.why: unknown type falls back to empty/!empty

vectors.name: filelink-folder-delims
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file: ";#" is an empty file link.

vectors.name: unknown-folder-delims-not-empty
vectors.why: unknown type ";#" is a value, so the folder row is evaluated normally
